title: didymopanax parviflorus
intro: Didymopanax parviflorus, commonly known as the Tītoki, is a plant species native to New Zealand. It is a shrub or small tree with small white flowers, and has been used in traditional Maori medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of the Tītoki plant include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the Tītoki plant include saponins and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects.
